name: B10-0045/2024 (Renew) – The deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the ‘Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice’
title: Resolution on the deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the “Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice”
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the Taliban to scrap a new law that bans women's voices from being heard in public. It says this adds to earlier bans on education, work and travel, and amounts to gender apartheid. The Parliament asks the Taliban to restore women's full role in public life, reopen shelters for victims of violence, and release women jailed for their own protection. It also asks the European Union to consider new sanctions and more aid.

- The Taliban are urged to repeal the law and let women speak and take part in public life.
- Afghan women and girls lose their voice, education, work and access to help.
- The European Union may impose new sanctions and give more aid; no immediate legal change.
